start_here: Say to your AI: "Switch on workflow:sample-this-computers-load with credential_name <the vault name of my own account database>." It reads this computer's load every five minutes and keeps it as load rows, so the load principle can be measured.
no_lists_because: The samples are kept as computer_readings rows of the person's own database; no list of the person's is needed.
instructions: 1. Switch on the five-minute wake of workflow:sample-this-computers-load, with credential_name set to the vault name of your own database.
2. Each run asks this computer for its load (tool:read-this-computers-load) and writes one load_1m row and one memory_pressure_free_pct row.
3. Read the rows in computer_readings; the principle load-stays-under-150-minutes-a-day counts minutes above 150 from them, and says unmeasured until a day of samples exists.
